headline: Jubo Dal activist shot dead in Dhaka's Kafrul, 2 others injured
summary: Unidentified assailants opened fire indiscriminately in Mirpur, leaving one dead and two others wounded.
details: A Jubo Dal activist, identified as Yusuf Ali (45), was killed and two others were injured after unidentified assailants opened fire in Dhaka's Kafrul on Friday night.
The incident occurred in front of Opex Garments in Mirpur-13 E Block, where four to five assailants fired indiscriminately.
The victims were taken to Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH) around 12:30 am on Saturday, where Yusuf Ali succumbed to his injuries.
The other two injured, Nalam Sardar (45) and Monir Hossain (32), are currently undergoing treatment at the hospital.
Yusuf Ali was an activist of the Kafrul Thana Jubo Dal and hailed from Barishal district.
Local residents reportedly caught one suspected assailant and handed him over to the police.
Kafrul Police Station Officer-in-Charge Saiful Islam stated that efforts are underway to identify and arrest the remaining suspects involved in the attack.
caption:
A Jubo Dal activist was shot dead and two others injured in a late-night attack in Dhaka's Kafrul.

A Jubo Dal activist, identified as Yusuf Ali (45), was killed and two others were injured after unidentified assailants opened fire in Dhaka's Kafrul on Friday night.

The incident occurred in front of Opex Garments in Mirpur-13 E Block, where four to five assailants fired indiscriminately.

The victims were taken to Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH) around 12:30 am on Saturday, where Yusuf Ali succumbed to his injuries.

The other two injured, Nalam Sardar (45) and Monir Hossain (32), are currently undergoing treatment at the hospital.

Yusuf Ali was an activist of the Kafrul Thana Jubo Dal and hailed from Barishal district.

Local residents reportedly caught one suspected assailant and handed him over to the police.

Kafrul Police Station Officer-in-Charge Saiful Islam stated that efforts are underway to identify and arrest the remaining suspects involved in the attack.

Source: Prothom Alo, The Daily Star

headline_marked: Iran [[sends missiles and drones to Houthis]] to pressure Red Sea
headline: Iran sends missiles and drones to Houthis to pressure Red Sea
summary: Reports indicate Iran dispatched IRGC commanders and military equipment via a Mahan Air flight to Yemen to boost Houthi capabilities.
details: Iran has reportedly sent Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) commanders, military advisors, and medium-range missile and drone equipment to Houthi rebels in Yemen. The shipment arrived on July 13 via a Mahan Air flight from Tehran.
caption:
Iran is reportedly boosting Houthi military capabilities with missiles and drones to exert pressure on the Red Sea.

Iran has reportedly sent Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) commanders, military advisors, and medium-range missile and drone equipment to Houthi rebels in Yemen. The shipment arrived on July 13 via a Mahan Air flight from Tehran.
